title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for angular momentum must be correctly stated as J = J0 e^(-lambda/m * t).

title: Equations of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly write the equations of motion in polar coordinates for the particle.

title: Angular Momentum Definition
description: Important Criteria: The student should define angular momentum as J = mr^2 * theta_dot before deriving its time dependence.

title: Integration Step
description: Important Criteria: The integration of dJ/dt = -lambda J/m must be correctly performed to find J as a function of time.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign mistakes in the equations of motion or during integration.

title: Initial Conditions
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the use of initial conditions, specifically J0, in the final expression.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that units are consistent throughout the derivation.
